_comment: Deliberate, reviewed divergences from the reference smali. Each entry must name the class, the method, and why the change is intended. The oracle reports anything not listed here as UNEXPLAINED - so this file is the record of every behavioural decision taken since the reconstruction reached equivalence.

deviations.reason: Reads BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME instead of a hardcoded string. Upstream kept the two in step by running sed over the smali at build time (reference/build.sh); this removes that drift permanently. Adds a generated BuildConfig class.

Bug fix: the bound was `mType <= names.length`, which indexes one past the end when mType equals the array length (reachable from a corrupted or hand-edited prefs file). Changed to `<`. See docs/ROADMAP.md 3.2.

The five prebuilt InputContext<sdk>.jar assets are replaced by one jar built from source by the :inputcontext module, so the SDK ladder that selected between them is gone. The variants only ever differed where hidden-API signatures changed between releases (ProfilerInfo, getRecentTasks().getList(), ActivityManager.getService(), moveTaskToFront's extra params); the rebuilt helper reaches those APIs reflectively, which defers signature resolution to runtime and lets one build cover every API level. See tools/inputcontext/README.md and ROADMAP 3.1.
ROADMAP 1.4: initialises the new search query field. See the new_members entry for the feature as a whole.

ROADMAP 1.4: onCreate no longer builds the list inline. It now gathers candidates once (gatherCandidates) and delegates display to render(), which re-runs on every filter change. Hence the large drop in references from this method - the work moved, it did not disappear.

ROADMAP 1.4: the icon load now calls the adapter's bounds-checked iconAt() instead of switching on AppSelectMode and indexing the activity's list directly. Same icons, but safe when the list is rebuilt under an in-flight task.

ROADMAP 1.5: adds a Backup section (Export settings / Import settings) with its own posOffsetBackup/posExportSettings/posImportSettings positions, shown regardless of feature mode; constructs SettingsViewHelper with the new (activity, fragment) constructor so it can route Storage Access Framework results back here. See the new_members entries for SettingsViewHelper.smali and SettingsViewFragment.smali.
ROADMAP 1.5: now delegates to the new (Activity, Fragment) constructor with a null fragment - SettingsViewActivity (dead code, never started) is the only caller that still uses this one-arg form.

ROADMAP 1.5: the Export settings / Import settings rows launch a Storage Access Framework picker (ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT / ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT) on API 19+ with a fragment to route the result to, falling back to the original InputDialog path-entry flow otherwise. The reference-only ColorDialog/InputDialog show() refs are the same devirtualization noise seen elsewhere in this method (show() resolves to the merged SettingsViewHelper$ANON receiver type instead of the builder base type) - not new behaviour.

ROADMAP 1.5: two new InputDialog subclasses (Export settings, Import settings) join this class's merged anonymous-subclass bucket - the pre-API-19 / no-fragment fallback for SettingsBackup.exportZip/importZip, reporting the result with a Toast.
ROADMAP 2.3: TaskerTask no longer needs root (see the Launcher.smali::doTaskerAction entry below), so its caption tag changes from [Root] to [None].

ROADMAP 2.3: runs the task via a plain sendBroadcast(TaskerIntents.runTask(...)) instead of shelling `am broadcast` through root. Same broadcast action and extra (net.dinglisch.android.tasker.ACTION_TASK / task_name) - only the delivery mechanism changes, now declaring the PERMISSION_RUN_TASKS manifest permission instead of needing a rooted device.

ROADMAP 2.3: TaskerTask opens Tasker's own task picker (ACTION_TASK_SELECT via startActivityForResult) when Tasker is installed, instead of the free-text name dialog; the dialog remains the fallback when resolveActivity finds no Tasker. See the new_members entry for the onActivityResult that receives the pick.

ROADMAP 3.5 fix: onInterrupt no longer clears instance/mInitialized. The system sends onInterrupt to every bound service whenever anything calls AccessibilityManager.interrupt() - 'stop your feedback', not a disconnect. Clearing state there left the service bound (Settings shows it enabled) but unusable until toggled off/on, the long-reported symptom. Now only logs.

ROADMAP 1.6 phase 1: builds the Material 3 shell (AppCompatActivity, MaterialToolbar inside an AppBarLayout, TabLayout, ViewPager2) in place of the deprecated ActionBar/ViewPager1 one. See the LMT.smali new_members (reworked) entry for the accompanying field changes.
ROADMAP 1.6 phase 1: reads/writes the same "tab" bundle key via ViewPager2.getCurrentItem() instead of ActionBar.getSelectedNavigationIndex().

ROADMAP 1.6 phase 1: now calls super.onActivityResult(), which FragmentActivity requires in order to forward results to child fragments (e.g. SettingsViewFragment's Storage Access Framework picker, ROADMAP 1.5) now that tabs are hosted through FragmentStateAdapter/ViewPager2 instead of the deleted FrameworkFragmentStatePagerAdapter.
ROADMAP 1.6 phase 1: same tab-set logic (Settings always first, Gestures+Isas iff mode<2, Pie iff mode>0, Info always last) rebuilt against TabsAdapter/TabLayoutMediator instead of ActionBar tabs.

ROADMAP 1.6 phase 1: drops the setUserVisibleHint(true) call. That ViewPager1-era API has no effect under ViewPager2's FragmentStateAdapter, which manages fragment visibility through fragment transactions instead.

ROADMAP 1.6 phase 1: this fragment now extends androidx.fragment.app.Fragment instead of the deprecated android.app.Fragment. androidx.fragment.app.Fragment#getActivity() returns FragmentActivity (an android.app.Activity subclass) instead of plain Activity, so every call site's compiled receiver type changes. No behavioural change - getActivity() still returns the hosting LMT activity.

D8 compiles this SimpleAdapter subclass's constructor (its small int literal setup) with a different instruction encoding at this minSdk floor - same 0/1/2 values, not a code change in this file. The same nums-only diff appears in every SimpleAdapter-derived constructor across the app (see GesturesFragment/IsasFragment/PieFragment/SettingsViewHelper's adapter constructors below).

Not a behavioural difference.

ROADMAP 1.6 phase 1 raises minSdk from 15 to 21. Below API 21, D8 wraps calls to APIs added after minSdk in synthetic Launcher$$ExternalSyntheticApiModelOutline0/$$ExternalSyntheticBackport* bridge classes, to protect Dalvik's eager class verification on pre-Lollipop devices; ART (API 21+) doesn't have that verification behaviour, so D8 stops generating the wrapper and calls the framework/JDK method directly. Same behaviour, different bytecode shape. No source in this file changed.

_note_fields: The 11 `$assertionsDisabled` synthetic fields were removed along with their uses: jadx renders them as a constant `false`, they are never part of a real assert (no AssertionError anywhere in the app), and javac already inlined the constant. The oracle reports their removal as synthetic-only field differences. MultiSelectActivity also gains instance fields for the search query, the system-app toggle and the unfiltered candidate lists (ROADMAP 1.4).
_comment_new_members: Classes where NEW members are expected because a feature was added there. Additions are accepted; anything MISSING is still reported, unless the entry sets "reworked": true, which means the class was deliberately restructured and removals are expected too. Every other class is unaffected either way.

new_members.reason: ROADMAP 1.4: app-picker search and system-app toggle. Adds gatherCandidates/render/matches/isSystem and the options menu, plus fields for the query, the toggle and the unfiltered candidate lists. Filtering rebuilds the backing list and the adapter together because onItemClick resolves a tap as mPackageInfos.get(position - 1).

ROADMAP 1.4: the adapter now carries its own model snapshot (mModel) instead of reaching into the activity's mutable list by position, and its constructor gained that parameter - so the old 3-arg constructor is gone by design. Icon loading moved into iconAt(), which bounds-checks. This fixed an IndexOutOfBoundsException crash: an AsyncTask queued before a filter change indexed past the end of the shorter list.
ROADMAP 1.4: the icon-loading AsyncTask now delegates to the adapter's bounds-checked iconAt() rather than indexing the activity's list itself.

ROADMAP 1.5: adds posOffsetBackup/posExportSettings/posImportSettings fields for the new Backup section's rows, a mFragment field and REQUEST_EXPORT_SETTINGS/REQUEST_IMPORT_SETTINGS request codes for the Storage Access Framework flow, the (Activity, Fragment) constructor overload, and canUseFilePicker/handleExportSettingsPicked/handleImportSettingsPicked/exportSettings/importSettings/toastFailure to drive it. ROADMAP 1.6 phase 1 additionally retypes mFragment from android.app.Fragment to androidx.fragment.app.Fragment, which is a same-kind addition under this entry.

ROADMAP 1.5: adds onActivityResult, which routes a Storage Access Framework pick back to SettingsViewHelper.handleExportSettingsPicked/handleImportSettingsPicked. Mirrors the existing pattern in PieFragment.onActivityResult for its icon picker.
ROADMAP 2.3: adds the REQUEST_TASKER_TASK_SELECT request code and onActivityResult, which stores the task name Tasker's picker returns as its result data string.
ROADMAP 3.5: adds onUnbind, which clears instance/mInitialized on a real disconnect - previously nothing did, so LMT kept calling into a dead service.

ROADMAP 1.4: loadShowSystemApps/saveShowSystemApps persist the app picker's 'show system apps' toggle. Missing from this file until ROADMAP 3.6 made one-sided methods actually fail the oracle - before that they only printed a warning.

ROADMAP 1.6 phase 1: Material 3 foundation. LMT becomes an AppCompatActivity built around a MaterialToolbar + TabLayout + ViewPager2 shell instead of the deprecated ActionBar/ViewPager1 one, so its field set changes: drops mTabsAdapter (TabsAdapter is now a local in createTabs(), since nothing outside LMT.java ever referenced it), retypes mViewPager to ViewPager2, and adds mTabLayout. See the accompanying deviations entries for onCreate/onSaveInstanceState/onActivityResult/createTabs.

ROADMAP 1.6 phase 1: rebuilt as a ViewPager2 FragmentStateAdapter (getItemCount/createFragment) in place of the deleted FrameworkFragmentStatePagerAdapter-derived adapter. None of the old ActionBar.TabListener/ViewPager.OnPageChangeListener methods carry over - tab selection now syncs automatically via TabLayoutMediator, which the reworked LMT$TabsAdapter$TabInfo removal (see removed_classes) also reflects: tabs are tracked as parallel title/fragment-class lists instead of a wrapper object.

ROADMAP 1.6 phase 1 adds the AndroidX/Material3 dependencies, which merge in many new resources and shift the numeric resource-ID space app-wide. This class's listitem_description_button field's baked-in R.id constant lands on a different numeric slot as a result (still the same resource, not a renamed or removed one) - reworked only to excuse that value-only field diff, not any real structural change.

_comment_classes: Whole classes present on only one side. new_classes: expected only in our build. removed_classes: expected only in the reference (deleted on purpose). Anything else on one side fails the oracle.

new_classes.reason: Generated by AGP once buildConfig is enabled, so getVersion() can read VERSION_NAME instead of a hardcoded string.
ROADMAP 1.5: import/export settings. Has no upstream counterpart.

D8's addSuppressed/equals backport for minSdk 15, generated fresh because SettingsBackup's try-with-resources blocks are the first in this dex's compile order to need it. Same kind of artifact as AccessibilityHandler's numbered backport class (EXPECTED_GONE_PREFIX in compare_fingerprints.py), attached to a different 'first' class since the class set changed.
ROADMAP 2.3: TaskerTask, de-rooted, plus Tasker's task picker. Has no upstream counterpart.

ROADMAP 1.6 phase 1: LMT's TabLayoutMediator.TabConfigurationStrategy lambda is the class's first anonymous/lambda class. The reference LMT has none - its TabsAdapter implemented ActionBar.TabListener/ViewPager.OnPageChangeListener directly - so there is no reference-side $ANON bucket to match against.

Same numbered-outline-helper artifact as SettingsBackup$$ExternalSyntheticBackport0 above: ROADMAP 1.6 phase 1 raises minSdk to 21, which changes which call sites still need D8's API-outlining helper, so D8 attaches a freshly-numbered instance of it to a different 'first' class (PieContainer$PieLayout) than before. PieContainer.java is untouched by this phase.

removed_classes.reason: ROADMAP 1.6 phase 1: TabsAdapter now tracks tabs as parallel title/fragment-class lists instead of a TabInfo wrapper object, since FragmentStateAdapter addresses tabs purely positionally (createFragment(int)/getItemCount()) and never needs to carry a Bundle of constructor args the way the old ActionBar/ViewPager1 adapter did.
